informal_statement: For \(\lambda>1\) and \(0<h<1\), the normalized three-arc area is differentiable at \(h\), and its perimeter has derivative \(h\) times that area derivative.
reason: Source `LeanSuffixAnalytic.lean:554-639`: The proof differentiates the explicit quotients and uses the radical cancellation to establish both derivative existence and the variational identity, not global area monotonicity.
